liveAcceptance.promptSource: user-authored default chat composer in the in-app browser
liveAcceptance.selectedRefCommandText: ask --ref "artifact:p4-canonical-ref-report" "Using only the selected artifact, report the token and the exact bullet topic that mentions RNA-seq.※1"

negativeChecks.noSelectedRefFirstTurn: The first live artifact command had no selected refs in the user message.
negativeChecks.noFakeSelectedRef: The selected-ref terminal text only appeared after the user selected p4-canonical-ref-report in the UI.
negativeChecks.seedDemoExcluded: The passing evidence uses live token P4-CANONICAL-REF-1835 and live command ids, not seed/demo artifacts.

acceptanceRubric.expectation: The live default-chat Runtime Codex turn must create or expose a user-facing research-report artifact containing the selected token.
acceptanceRubric.observed: Runtime Codex wrote workspace/parallel/p4/artifacts/p4-canonical-ref-report.md; UI exposed artifact:p4-canonical-ref-report with inline markdown preview containing P4-CANONICAL-REF-1835.

acceptanceRubric.expectation: After a user selects the artifact/ref, the follow-up must become terminal-equivalent text with a generic selected ref, and the answer must use that ref content.
acceptanceRubric.observed: Runtime Codex native session recorded ask --ref "artifact:p4-canonical-ref-report"; the answer returned the token and the RNA-seq differential expression bullet from the artifact.

acceptanceRubric.expectation: Artifact content must open or read through preview/file API/state refs consistently.
acceptanceRubric.observed: UI inline preview rendered the markdown artifact; workspace file API returned the same token and bullet content.

acceptanceRubric.expectation: Workspace refresh must restore artifact, run, message, and selected refs from session state.
acceptanceRubric.observed: After reload, the session restored the artifact preview, two completed runs, messages, and selected user ref artifact:p4-canonical-ref-report.

acceptanceRubric.expectation: M0 final live acceptance ultimately expects ConversationProjection/gui.present to drive the main result pane.
acceptanceRubric.observed: Artifact open/follow-up is live usable, but the right result view still says it is waiting for ConversationProjection for the focused run.

notes: Runtime bridge now starts Codex with workspace-write sandbox and approval never, matching the documented backend wrapper.
Runtime Codex artifact ids returned as artifact:* are canonicalized before building UI ObjectReference refs, preventing artifact:artifact:* commandText.
The v1 failed evidence is kept in this manifest for regression context.
